welcome.title: Abyssal Claims
welcome.description: An <bold>environmental transparency platform</bold> spanning the ocean and land. 50+ data layers — deep-sea mining claims, ocean carbon and acidification, Arctic land-to-ocean change, biodiversity, and live ocean sensors — sourced from real scientific databases. Click any feature for detail, or combine layers to reveal overlaps and change.
welcome.subtitle: Choose your focus

hint.layers: Toggle layers on the left — concessions, species, vents, mine footprints, fires, and more
hint.pin: Click any feature for analysis, risk scores, and impact reports

welcome.footer: Each mode loads a curated set of layers. You can toggle additional layers on or off from the panel on the left. Enabling many layers at once may slow down your browser.
